# hetznerrobot_storagebox (Resource)

The settings of an existing Storage Box. Robot cannot create one through the webservice, so this resource adopts the box by `id`; destroying it only removes it from state. Only the inclusive **BX10 (100 GB)** Storage Box of a dedicated server is still managed through Robot; every other Storage Box moved to the [Hetzner Console API](https://docs.hetzner.cloud/reference/hetzner#storage-boxes) (the `hcloud` provider). Every Storage Box write is limited to one request per 5 seconds, which the provider waits out.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The inclusive BX10 Storage Box of a dedicated server. Robot cannot create a
# box, so the resource adopts it by id; destroying it only forgets it.
resource "hetznerrobot_storagebox" "backup" {
  id                    = 123456
  name                  = "backup"
  ssh                   = true
  samba                 = false
  webdav                = false
  external_reachability = true
  password              = var.storagebox_password
}

variable "storagebox_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) Storage Box id.

### Optional

- `external_reachability` (Boolean) Whether the box is reachable from outside the Hetzner network.
- `name` (String) Name of the Storage Box.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password of the main user. Set, it is applied whenever it changes; left out, the password is not touched. Robot never returns it, so a change made elsewhere goes unnoticed. 12–128 characters with upper and lower case letters, a digit and a special character.
- `samba` (Boolean) Whether Samba (SMB/CIFS) access is enabled.
- `ssh` (Boolean) Whether SSH (SFTP, SCP, rsync, BorgBackup) access is enabled.
- `webdav` (Boolean) Whether WebDAV access is enabled.
- `zfs` (Boolean) Whether the ZFS snapshot directory is visible.

### Read-Only

- `cancelled` (Boolean) Whether the box is cancelled.
- `disk_quota` (Number) Total space in MB.
- `disk_usage` (Number) Used space in MB.
- `disk_usage_data` (Number) Space used by data in MB.
- `disk_usage_snapshots` (Number) Space used by snapshots in MB.
- `host_system` (String) Identifier of the host system.
- `linked_server` (Number) Number of the server the box belongs to.
- `location` (String) Location of the box.
- `locked` (Boolean) Whether the box is locked.
- `login` (String) Main user name, e.g. `u12345`.
- `paid_until` (String) Paid-until date.
- `product` (String) Product, e.g. `BX10`.
- `server` (String) Host name to connect to, e.g. `u12345.your-storagebox.de`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
tofu import hetznerrobot_storagebox.backup 123456
```
